remarks.text: Tram M1: Replacement service due to construction works between Schönhauser Allee/Bornholmer Str. and U Eberswalder Str.. At night, additionally between Am Kupfergraben and the S+U Alexanderplatz/Gontardstr. [MEHR/MORE]
